meta.description: Twists the paths of a bundle around the line they run along, more towards the tip, like the fibres of a rope. Paths that grow on the same parent are one bundle, e.g. the strands of a stipe. Put it before nodes that cut paths short, like random_break.

plant.description: The paths to twist. Paths with the same parent and the same creator are one bundle.

turns.description: How often a bundle turns around its line from base to tip. 0 leaves the paths where they are.

depth.description: On which layers of paths to work, counted from the deepest. 1 twists only the deepest paths, e.g. the strands.
